title: Hello from AmA Studio
excerpt: A new game studio from Cairo, serious about fun.
body: AmA Studio is open. AmA stands for AmAzing, and that is the bar we set for every game we make.
We make small, bright games for everyday breaks: easy to learn in a minute, fun for months.
Our first game, Kinfold, is on its way. Join the newsletter to hear first when it lands.

title: Kinfold is coming
excerpt: Our first game: a bright category card puzzle set in Egypt.
body: Kinfold is a category card puzzle with an Egyptian twist. Look at the cards, drop each one into its group, and clear the board.
It is coming to iOS and Android. More screenshots and a release date soon.
